influences.name: George Martin
influences.context: Fishmans benefitted from a long working relationship with recording engineer Kazuyuki "Zak" Matsumura, whose influence Motegi compares to that of producer George Martin on the Beatles.

influences.name: Kazuyuki "Zak" Matsumura
influences.context: He showed us how to strip things back, and reduce our music to the bare essentials. I feel like Zak taught us a lot about how to generate a sense of tension.

influences.name: AC/DC
influences.context: Out of nowhere, he volunteers that AC/DC's Back in Black was probably similar.

influences.name: Kiyoshiro Imawano
influences.context: The band periodically reconvenes for festival dates and the occasional headlining show, revisiting its old material for the benefit of longstanding fans and newer listeners who missed out first time around. This marked the beginning of the second phase of Fishmans' career, with a rotating cast of guest vocalists including Sato's old hero, Kiyoshiro Imawano.
